_purpose: Room 4D — Project 001, D-001B Phase 1. Groups of questions that test the same or overlapping knowledge, detected during import. Duplicates are never deleted — grouping them preserves the signal that a repeated concept may indicate exam importance.

groups.reason: Both questions share the identical stem "From the choices below select the one which is false about Social Security (OASDHI):" and three of four answer choices are worded identically (or near-identically) across the two versions. Each version's 4th/distinct choice ('fully funded' vs. 'benefits closely match contributions') is marked as the false statement in its own version — these are two different printed variants of the same stock exam question testing the same underlying false-statement-about-OASDHI concept, not a verbatim repeat.
